title: LegalDocumentManifest
description: Spec-ahead (ADR 0009). One manifest per environment: the single source of that environment's legal documents, read by the app (bundled offline copy of the same version) and by the environment's landing page (#371). $defs.acceptance is the per-user acceptance record. No code anchor yet; moves to schemas/ once implemented.

kind.description: The owner as a private person

contactEmail.description: Published contact for the operator and data requests: a dedicated FoodSavr mailbox, never the owner's personal email. The placeholder legal-contact@placeholder.invalid stands in until the owner provides it; the pre-paid-launch gate fails while it remains

documentKind.description: tester for development, test and staging; privacy, terms and subscription for production

materialChange.description: true: users who accepted an earlier version must accept this one

nb.description: Repository path of the nb text

en.description: Repository path of the en text

publicPath.description: Path on the environment's landing page, for example /legal/privacy (#371)

acceptance.description: A user's acceptance of one document version; append-only, one record per accepted version. Existing accounts accept the first versioned documents on their next launch.

ageDeclaration.description: Self-declared age at sign-up, stored with the account. The minimum age to create an account or pay is 18.

adult.description: The user declared to be 18 or older

guardianConsent.description: An adult's consent for a member aged 13 to 17 invited to their Family household, recorded when the guardian sends the invite. The guardian withdraws it by removing the member, which sets withdrawnAt and pauses the minor's account.

guardianUid.description: UID of the consenting adult (the household's invited-by adult)

memberUid.description: UID of the member aged 13 to 17

documentVersion.description: Version of the document the guardian consented to
